name: Amamori Sou
source:
He's a young man, who is studying planted-related things, and is employed at the same research establishment as Sayo.

He seems gentle and calm at first glance, but he's actually pretty shrewd and calculating and hides his true intentions.

He's been an acquaintance of the main character since she came to the research establishment.

[From [url=https://sites.google.com/site/ikuseinikki/characters]Twin Project[/url]]
